heroSlides.title: Sri Lanka's Iconic Taste Since 1884
heroSlides.desc: Freshly baked traditional meat pies, flaky savouries, celebratory gateaux, and authentic Dutch lamprais delivered right to your doorstep.

heroSlides.desc: Steamed slow in fresh banana leaf with samba rice, four-meat curry, frikkadel meatballs, spicy blachan, and seeni sambol.

heroSlides.title: Handcrafted Ribbon Cakes & Gateaux
heroSlides.desc: Celebrate special milestones with our signature multi-layered ribbon cakes, decadent chocolate fudge, and fresh gateaux.

heroSlides.title: Legendary Chinese Rolls & Savouries
heroSlides.desc: Crispy beef Chinese rolls, spicy fish patties, and savoury mutton pastries — Ceylon's favourite teatime snack since 1884.

heroSlides.title: Premier Outdoor Catering Across Colombo
heroSlides.desc: From intimate family functions to grand corporate cocktail gatherings, let Green Cabin take care of the culinary magic.

settings.aboutTitle: Over 140 Years of Authentic Ceylon Culinary Excellence
settings.aboutText1: Green Cabin, managed under the proud stewardship of Cyril Rodrigo Restaurants, traces its illustrious heritage back to 1884 when it first began as the Ceylon Tea Kiosk at the Colombo Harbour. Over generations, Green Cabin has evolved into a household name, cherished for its legendary puff pastry meat pies, short eats, festive ribbon cakes, and authentic Sri Lankan flavours.
settings.aboutText2: From historic banquet catering to daily morning savouries, our master bakers and chefs preserve the secret family spice blends and traditional recipes that have delighted generations of Sri Lankans and international visitors alike.
settings.footerAbout: Carrying on the culinary legacy of Cyril Rodrigo Restaurants since 1884. Iconic Sri Lankan taste, authentic recipes, and warm hospitality.

products.name: Mutton Lamprais
products.desc: A Sri Lankan Dutch Burger delicacy. The word Lamprais is derived from the Dutch word "Lomprijst", which loosely translates to mean a packet of food. This banana leaf wrapped treat comprises of a mutton curry, Ash Plantain, Brinjal Pahi, Seeni Sambol, Blachan (Shrimp Paste), Cutlet and finally rice cooked in stock.
